title: Price Owed Before Delivery under a Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) Award
content:
For the pre-delivery balance on a Riverbend Self-Pay Package Price - Maternity & Delivery package under Good Faith & Price Estimates, an approved award of the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) covering the expected delivery date changes the delivery package price owed before delivery — the price from which the deposits held are taken off.

**Rule.** When the covering award's tier discount is above zero and below one hundred percent, the delivery package price owed before delivery is the delivery package price reduced by that discount percentage. When the covering award carries no tier discount and has cap left, it is the smaller of the delivery package price and the cap left. In every other case the award does not change the price owed before delivery.

**Record terms.** The patient's award is the patient's approved financial assistance case, a patient holding at most one approved case at a time; it covers the expected delivery date (the scheduled service date on the estimate) when that date falls within its award period, from its award start date through its award end date, both counted. Its tier discount is the discount percentage of its Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care) tier; its cap left is its hardship liability cap less the liabilities already booked on encounters under that case. The delivery package price is the Riverbend facility line plus the Riverbend professional line carrying the principal service code on the current version.

| Covers the date | Tier discount | Cap left | Delivery package price owed before delivery |
|---|---|---|---|
| yes | above 0, below 100 percent | any | delivery package price reduced by the discount |
| yes | 0 | above zero | smaller of the delivery package price and the cap left |
| yes | 0 | none | not changed by the award |
| yes | 100 percent | any | not changed by the award |
| no, or no approved case | any | any | not changed by the award |

Examples (hypothetical): price 10000.00 with a 60 percent discount, owed before delivery 4000.00; no discount and 2500.00 of cap left, 2500.00.
